sentences.text: Fifteen years ago, I took a summer vacation in Lecce in southern Italy.
After climbing up a hill for a panoramic view of the blue sea, white buildings and green olive trees, I paused to catch my breath and then positioned myself to take the best photo of this panorama.

paras.zh: 十五年前，我在意大利南部的莱切度过了一个暑假。爬上一座小山，为了俯瞰蓝色的大海、白色的建筑和绿色的橄榄树，我停下来喘口气，然后调整好自己的位置，想拍下这幅全景的最佳照片。

sentences.text: Unfortunately, just as I took out my camera, a woman approached from behind, and planted herself right in front of my view.
Like me, this woman was here to stop, sigh and appreciate the view.

paras.zh: 不幸的是，就在我拿出相机的时候，一位女士从后面走来，径直站在了我的视野前。和我一样，这位女士也是来这里驻足、叹息并欣赏风景的。

sentences.text: Patient as I was, after about 15 minutes, my camera scanning the sun and reviewing the shot I would eventually take, I grew frustrated.
Was it too much to ask her to move so I could take just one picture of the landscape?
Sure, I could have asked her, but something prevented me from doing so.
She seemed so content in her observation.
I didn't want to mess with that.

paras.zh: 尽管我很有耐心，但大约十五分钟后，我的相机扫视着阳光，审视着我最终会拍下的镜头，我开始感到沮丧。让她挪一下，好让我拍一张风景照，这要求过分吗？当然，我本可以问她，但有什么东西阻止了我这样做。她在自己的观察中显得如此满足。我不想打扰她。

sentences.text: Another 15 minutes passed and I grew bored.
The woman was still there.
I decided to take the photo anyway.
And now when I look at it, I think her presence in the photo is what makes the image interesting.
The landscape, beautiful on its own, somehow comes to life and breathes because this woman is engaging with it.

paras.zh: 又过了十五分钟，我开始感到无聊。那位女士还在那里。我决定不管怎样还是拍下这张照片。而现在当我看着它时，我认为她在照片中的存在正是让这幅画面有趣的地方。风景本身就很美，但不知怎的，因为这位女士在与它互动，它变得生动起来，仿佛有了呼吸。

sentences.text: This photo, with the unique beauty that unfolded before me and that woman who "ruined" it, now hangs on a wall in my bedroom.
What would she think if she knew that her figure is captured and frozen on some stranger's bedroom wall?
A bedroom, after all, is a very private space, in which some woman I don't even know has been immortalized.
In some ways, she lives in my house.

paras.zh: 这张照片，带着展现在我眼前的独特美景，以及那个"毁掉"它的女人，现在挂在我卧室的墙上。如果她知道她的身影被捕捉并定格在某个陌生人的卧室墙上，她会怎么想？毕竟，卧室是一个非常私密的空间，而我甚至不认识的一位女士却被永远铭记在了那里。在某种程度上，她住在我的房子里。

sentences.text: Perhaps we all live in each others' spaces.
Perhaps this is what photos are for: to remind us that we all appreciate beauty, that we all share a common desire for pleasure, for connection, for something that is greater than us.

paras.zh: 也许我们都生活在彼此的空间里。也许这就是照片的意义所在：提醒我们，我们都欣赏美，我们都对快乐、对联系、对某种比我们更伟大的东西有着共同的渴望。

sentences.text: That photo is a reminder, a captured moment, an unspoken conversation between two women, separated only by a thin square of glass.

paras.zh: 那张照片是一个提醒，一个被捕捉的瞬间，两位女性之间一场无声的对话，她们之间只隔着一块薄薄的方形玻璃。
